_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Tape remains a coil (F&G ~50, VIX ~19, flat funding, modest drift) so the score stays inside the Complacency band unless flows or F&G break the range.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split: analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies bearish intake data without a phase call; neither supports an aggressive directional break
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, BTC range-stable, exchange netflow cools, funding stays flat
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below 40 with ETF flows near 0 and elevated exchange inflows (slide to Anxiety), or F&G >62 with ETF rebound (lift toward Disbelief)
